thread:
maya: quick sync — ran the AZ8 runbook dry-run yesterday with the oncall pair. compiling a short list of edits + known gotchas before we hand this to SRE.

 tomas: thanks. can you paste the failures you saw? i was on the infra side for the dry-run.

 maya: main items:
- networking: MTU mismatch on transit VPC caused fragmented TLS handshakes to some model servers. reproduction steps inlined below.
- node provisioning: 2 of 12 GPU instances failed nvidia-driver install due to kernel package mismatch (ubuntu HWE vs GA kernels).
- kube: kube-proxy conntrack high churn on bursty loads; recommend conntrack table bump and prometheus alert.
- quota: cloud GPU quota hit for p-spots when we tried a scale test; need to add quota checklist and fallback plan to runbook.
- cost: spot preemption sim was noisy — add guidance for preferred instance families and preemption SLO.

 sasha: MTU issue — saw this too. quick repro (from bastion):
```
# from bastion to model node
ping -M do -s 1472 <model-node-ip>
# if this fails, TLS sessions may stall when using larger frames
```
fix is to ensure transit GW MTU 8950 and ENI MTU 9001 are consistent in cloud config. added note to networking section.

 leah: on the nvidia-driver failures — logs looked like:
```
ERROR: package 'linux-headers-5.15.0-xx-generic' not found
dkms: ERROR: could not locate kernel headers
```
we should add a pre-provision check that verifies `uname -r` against installed headers and bail with a clear remediation.

 ryan: for kube conntrack — what numbers were you hitting? i can template an alert.

 maya: peaked ~110k conntrack entries on a 128k table during our 10s ramp test. recommend add runbook blurb:
- check `sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_count` and `nf_conntrack_max`.
- temporary fix: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144` (document risks)
- long term: tune service mesh sidecar timeouts + batching.

 sasha: +1 to alert template. also add a one-liner command for quick triage: `ss -tunap | grep ESTABLISHED | wc -l`.

 infra-runbook-bot: auto-note: updated draft runbook in /docs/infra/az8-runbook-draft.md (version v0.3) — please review.

 maya: pushed a small PR to the draft with suggested sections: pre-provision checks, network validation, post-provision smoke tests, handoff checklist. PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/az8-runbook/pull/42

 tomas: nit: under post-provision smoke tests include `nvidia-smi -q --gpu=0 | grep Product` to detect driver/firmware mismatch early.

 leah: also add kernel header install steps for ubuntu images and a link to our golden image manifest. many failures were from using HWE images in the cloud console accidentally.

 ryan: quota note — we hit p-spots limit in eu-west-1. runbook should list the exact quota checks and a fallback mapping (e.g., p4 -> g5/alternative families) and a contact path to cloud quota support. add the command to fetch quotas: `gcloud compute regions describe eu-west1 --format=json` (or provider equivalent).

 maya: known issues section (draft bullets):
- MTU mismatch between transit GW and instance ENI causing large-frame TLS stalls. workaround: set MTU align, or enforce smaller MSS on bastion.
- Kernel headers mismatch for ubuntu HWE images -> nvidia-driver DKMS fails. workaround: install matching headers or use golden image.
- Spot preemption noise: scale tests with short-lived workers trigger preemptions; recommended scale test window >= 5m and use diversified families.
- kube-proxy/conntrack spikes under bursty tokenization loads. workaround: raise nf_conntrack_max, add alert and backpressure.

 sasha: can we add a short troubleshooting flow for the MTU case? like quick checks and a binary decision tree.

 maya: yes — added a 3-step triage in the PR:
1) `ip -s link show <eni>` confirm MTU
2) `tracepath -n <model-ip>` to detect MTU hop
3) if mismatch, apply temporary `ip link set dev <eni> mtu 9000` and file cloud ticket for transit GW config

 ryan: about cost guidance — include an explicit run rate estimate per 100 GPU nodes and a short note on commit vs. on-demand economics. ops finance asked for that in the handoff.

 leah: i'll draft the cost table. will add recommended instance families and expected $/hour for steady vs burst.

 tomas: on handoff — propose the checklist include:
- runbook PR merged + grepped for TODOs
- smoke tests (kube readiness, nvidia-smi, network path) green
- documented fallback plan for quota/spot incidents
- oncall rotation assigned and runbook owner noted

 maya: perfect. next steps:
- leah: cost table draft by EOD thurs
- ryan: alert templates + playbook snippets (conntrack & quota) by tomorrow
- sasha: networking triage tree + verify MTU docs by EOD
- tomas: add the kernel-header precheck + nvidia-smi check to PR
- maya: consolidate and move PR to ops-review once items in

 oncall-bot: reminder: weekly SRE sync Thu 11:00 — suggest we reserve 15m to review AZ8 handoff.

 sasha: ack. will join and run through network slides.

 leah: ack — will have cost table draft.

 maya: thanks team. i'll update PR with the above bullets and ping when ready for review. :thumbsup:
